objectives: 本課程是為半年制研究生設計的。我們從回顧測度理論開始，介紹 Borel-Cantelli 引理，大數定律，Martingle等。目的是為在工作中運用概率的人們提供許多重要的想法和思考。
content: “1. Review: Lebesque-Stieltjes measures and Caratheodory extension theorems 2. Review: Integration  3. Probability spaces and sigma-algebras 4. Random variables and distributions 5. Laws of large numbers and independence6. Weak laws of large numbers 7. Midterm exam8. Borel-Cantelli lemmas and Strong Laws of Large Numbers: Colivenko-Cantelli theorem and Central limit theorem 9. Zero-one laws and maximal inequalities 10. Independent sums and larges deviations 11. De Moivre-Laplace theorem, weak convergence and characteristic functions12. Central limit theorem and its variants13. Random walks: stopping times and recurrence 14. Random walks: renewal theory 15. Martingales and Radon-Nikodym derivatives 16. Final exam“
books: “Durret, R. Probability: theory and examples,(2nd edn.), Duxburry. Belmont. Calif, 2005WILLIAMS, David. Probability with martingales. Cambridge university press, 1991.“
grading_policy: “In this course, we will have three quizzes (30％), midterm exam (35％), final exam (35％), and assignments (40％).“

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限統計研究所博士班。
